description: Source code for a Ninja build file parser and related utilities, including classes for environment management, parsing logic, and dependency file handling.

classes.name: EvalEnv
classes.description: Dictionary subclass for environment variable management with recursive lookup.

classes.name: BuildEvalEnv
classes.description: Environment class that extends EvalEnv with build and rule environments.

classes.name: EvalError
classes.description: Base exception class for evaluation errors.

classes.name: EvalCircularError
classes.description: Exception for circular variable substitution errors.

classes.name: EvalString
classes.description: Tuple subclass representing strings with variable segments for substitution.

classes.name: Build
classes.description: Data structure representing a build rule with outputs, inputs, and dependencies.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Data structure representing a build rule with a name and bindings.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: Data structure representing a resource pool with a name and bindings.

classes.name: Default
classes.description: Data structure representing default build targets.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Named tuple for lexical tokens with kind, line, column, and value.

classes.name: TK
classes.description: Enumeration of token types used in lexing.

classes.name: TokenMatcher
classes.description: Class for matching tokens based on regex patterns.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Lexical analyzer for reading and tokenizing ninja build files.

classes.name: Manifest
classes.description: Named tuple containing parsed build, rule, pool, and default data.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Parser class for reading and interpreting ninja build manifest files.

classes.name: DepFileRecord
classes.description: Data structure for dependency file records.

classes.name: DepFileParser
classes.description: Parser for ninja dependency log files.

methods.name: _eval_string
methods.description: Recursively evaluate segments of an EvalString, substituting variables.

methods.name: eval_string
methods.description: Evaluate a string or EvalString in a given environment, returning the result.

methods.name: eval_path_strings
methods.description: Evaluate a list of EvalStrings as paths, normalizing and interning them.
